title: Every SORRY Here Costs An Inch ☕
description:
In our town, every sorry shrinks you an inch. My aunt Mae is the size of a mug, and everybody says she's the politest woman alive.

Every Sunday I play her at cards on her sun porch. I've lost sixty games in a row.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MUG if you'd be her size by now.
